SELECT
  w.wordid AS word_id,
  w.word AS word,
  total_synsets,
  total_senses,
  distinct_domains,
  distinct_posids,
  (SELECT s.synsetid FROM senses s 
   WHERE s.wordid = w.wordid 
   GROUP BY s.synsetid 
   ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s.synsetid ASC 
   LIMIT 1) AS top_synsetid,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM senses s 
   WHERE s.wordid = w.wordid 
   AND s.synsetid = (SELECT s2.synsetid FROM senses s2 
                     WHERE s2.wordid = w.wordid 
                     GROUP BY s2.synsetid 
                     ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s2.synsetid ASC 
                     LIMIT 1)) AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM (
  SELECT 
    w.wordid,
    w.word,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets,
    COUNT(*) AS total_senses,
    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM words w
  JOIN senses s ON w.wordid = s.wordid
  JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid
  GROUP BY w.wordid, w.word
  HAVING total_synsets >= 2
    AND distinct_domains >= 2 
    AND total_senses >= 2
) w
ORDER BY
  total_senses DESC,
  total_synsets DESC,
  distinct_domains DESC,
  word_id ASC
LIMIT 500;---

command: cd /app && sqlite3 -readonly oewn.sqlite ".schema" && echo '=== INDEXES ===' && sqlite3 -readonly oewn.sqlite "SELECT name, tbl_name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index';" && echo '=== ROW COUNTS ===' && sqlite3 -readonly oewn.sqlite "SELECT 'words',COUNT(*) FROM words UNION ALL SELECT 'senses',COUNT(*) FROM senses UNION ALL SELECT 'synsets',COUNT(*) FROM synsets;" && echo '=== TIMING ORIGINAL ===' && time sqlite3 -readonly oewn.sqlite < my-sql-query.sql | tail -3

cat <<'EOF' > /app/sol.sql
WITH sc AS (
  SELECT s.wordid AS wordid, s.synsetid AS synsetid, syn.domainid AS domainid, syn.posid AS posid, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM senses s JOIN synsets syn ON syn.synsetid = s.synsetid
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid, syn.domainid, syn.posid
), r AS (
  SELECT wordid, synsetid, cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wordid ORDER BY cnt DESC, synsetid ASC) AS rn
  FROM sc
), agg AS (
  SELECT wordid, SUM(cnt) AS total_senses, COUNT(*) AS total_synsets,
         COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) AS distinct_domains, COUNT(DISTINCT posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM sc
  GROUP BY wordid
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) >= 2 AND SUM(cnt) >= 2
)
SELECT w.wordid AS word_id, w.word AS word, a.total_synsets, a.total_senses,
       a.distinct_domains, a.distinct_posids, r.synsetid AS top_synsetid, r.cnt AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM agg a
JOIN words w ON w.wordid = a.wordid
JOIN r ON r.wordid = a.wordid AND r.rn = 1
ORDER BY a.total_senses DESC, a.total_synsets DESC, a.distinct_domains DESC, w.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;
EOF
cd /app && test -s /app/sol.sql && { printf 'EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN '; cat /app/sol.sql; } | sqlite3 -readonly /app/oewn.sqlite >/dev/null && echo SYNTAX_OK
echo '=== dup check ==='
sqlite3 -readonly /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM synsets) - (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT synsetid) FROM synsets) AS dup_synsetids, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM words) - (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wordid) FROM words) AS dup_wordids;"
echo '=== timing new query ==='
cd /app && time sqlite3 -readonly oewn.sqlite < sol.sql > /tmp/sol.out; wc -l /tmp/sol.out; head -5 /tmp/sol.out

cd /app && echo '=== orphan/fk checks ===' && sqlite3 -readonly oewn.sqlite "SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM senses s WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM synsets y WHERE y.synsetid=s.synsetid)) AS senses_without_synset, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM senses s WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM words w WHERE w.wordid=s.wordid)) AS senses_without_word;" && echo '=== independent aggregate reference ===' && time sqlite3 -readonly oewn.sqlite "SELECT w.wordid, w.word, COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS ts, COUNT(*) AS tn, COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS dd, COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS dp FROM words w JOIN senses s ON s.wordid=w.wordid JOIN synsets syn ON syn.synsetid=s.synsetid GROUP BY w.wordid, w.word HAVING ts>=2 AND dd>=2 AND tn>=2 ORDER BY tn DESC, ts DESC, dd DESC, w.wordid ASC LIMIT 500;" > /tmp/ref.out && wc -l /tmp/ref.out && cut -d'|' -f1-6 /tmp/sol.out | diff - /tmp/ref.out >/dev/null && echo AGGREGATE_COLUMNS_IDENTICAL || echo AGGREGATE_MISMATCH && IDS=$(cut -d'|' -f1 /tmp/sol.out | head -100 | paste -sd, -) && python3 - "$IDS" <<'PY' > /tmp/orig_subset.sql
import sys
ids = sys.argv[1]
q = open('/app/my-sql-query.sql').read()
old = "JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid"
assert q.count(old) == 1
q = q.replace(old, old + " WHERE w.wordid IN (%s)" % ids, 1)
print(q)
PY
echo '=== restricted original (100 words) ===' && time sqlite3 -readonly oewn.sqlite < /tmp/orig_subset.sql > /tmp/orig_sub.out && wc -l /tmp/orig_sub.out && head -100 /tmp/sol.out > /tmp/a.txt && sort /tmp/a.txt > /tmp/a.s && sort /tmp/orig_sub.out > /tmp/b.s && diff /tmp/a.s /tmp/b.s && echo SUBSET_FULL_ROWS_IDENTICAL

cd /app && echo '=== ref aggregate (timeout 120) ===' && timeout 120 sqlite3 -readonly oewn.sqlite "SELECT w.wordid, w.word, COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS ts, COUNT(*) AS tn, COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS dd, COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS dp FROM words w JOIN senses s ON s.wordid=w.wordid JOIN synsets syn ON syn.synsetid=s.synsetid GROUP BY w.wordid, w.word HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid)>=2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid)>=2 AND COUNT(*)>=2 ORDER BY tn DESC, ts DESC, dd DESC, w.wordid ASC LIMIT 500;" > /tmp/ref.out; echo "ref_rows=$(wc -l < /tmp/ref.out)"; cut -d'|' -f1-6 /tmp/sol.out | diff - /tmp/ref.out > /tmp/aggdiff.txt && echo AGGREGATE_COLUMNS_IDENTICAL || { echo AGGREGATE_MISMATCH; head -20 /tmp/aggdiff.txt; }; echo '=== full-row subset check (5 words) ==='; IDS=$(cut -d'|' -f1 /tmp/sol.out | head -5 | paste -sd, -); echo "ids=$IDS"; python3 - "$IDS" <<'PY' > /tmp/orig_subset.sql
import sys
ids = sys.argv[1]
q = open('/app/my-sql-query.sql').read()
anchor = "JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid"
assert q.count(anchor) == 1
q = q.replace(anchor, anchor + " WHERE w.wordid IN (%s)" % ids, 1)
open('/tmp/orig_subset.sql','w').write(q)
PY
timeout 150 sqlite3 -readonly oewn.sqlite < /tmp/orig_subset.sql > /tmp/orig_sub.out; echo "orig_rows=$(wc -l < /tmp/orig_sub.out)"; cut -d'|' -f1 /tmp/sol.out | head -5 | while read id; do grep -F "$id|" /tmp/sol.out; done | sort > /tmp/a.s; sort /tmp/orig_sub.out > /tmp/b.s; diff /tmp/a.s /tmp/b.s && echo SUBSET_FULL_ROWS_IDENTICAL; echo '--- sample ---'; head -5 /tmp/a.s

cd /app && IDS=$(cut -d'|' -f1 /tmp/sol.out | head -5 | paste -sd, -) && echo "ids=$IDS" && awk -v ids="$IDS" '{ if (!d && index($0,"JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid")) { print $0 " WHERE w.wordid IN (" ids ")"; d=1 } else print }' my-sql-query.sql > /tmp/orig_subset.sql && sed -n '18,30p' /tmp/orig_subset.sql && timeout 200 sqlite3 -readonly oewn.sqlite < /tmp/orig_subset.sql > /tmp/orig_sub.out; echo "orig_rows=$(wc -l < /tmp/orig_sub.out)"; cut -d'|' -f1 /tmp/sol.out | head -5 | while read id; do grep -F "$id|" /tmp/sol.out; done | sort > /tmp/a.s; sort /tmp/orig_sub.out > /tmp/b.s; diff /tmp/a.s /tmp/b.s && echo SUBSET_FULL_ROWS_IDENTICAL; echo '--- sample ---'; head -5 /tmp/b.s
